description: This Java source file defines the class GetSortBsonVisitor, which implements methods for converting sort field expressions into MongoDB BSON sort specifications. It includes static methods for building sort directives, projections, and extracting sort values, as well as methods for translating sort expressions into document paths.

classes.name: GetSortBsonVisitor
classes.description: A visitor class that creates BSON sort specifications from sort field expressions.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Generates a list of BSON sort directives from a sort field expression and sort direction.

methods.name: projections
methods.description: Builds a BSON Document representing the projected sort keys based on a list of sort options.

methods.name: sortValuesAsArray
methods.description: Converts sort options into a JSON array of their corresponding values from a BSON document.

methods.name: path
methods.description: Translates a sort field expression into a string path used in BSON documents.

methods.name: visitAttribute
methods.description: Constructs a sort key for an attribute using a mapping function.

methods.name: visitFeatureIdProperty
methods.description: Constructs a sort key for a feature property using a mapping function.

methods.name: visitSimple
methods.description: Returns the field name or maps it if it starts with a slash.

methods.name: getSortBson
methods.description: Creates a singleton list containing a BSON sort object for ascending or descending order.

methods.name: seekToPath
methods.description: Returns a function that retrieves a value from a BSON document given a dot-separated path.

methods.name: seekToPathImpl
methods.description: Recursively retrieves nested values from a BSON document along a path.
